retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast, low-key photographic composition featuring a rebellious subject leaning on a motorcycle, paired with heavy block and stencil typography.

recipe.visualDefinition: A central high-contrast black and white photograph of a child in a helmet leaning against a custom chopper motorcycle, flanked by a heavy gold-framed block logo in the top left and expressive stencil-style text in the top right.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject leaning against a diagonal motorcycle frame
Heavy gold rectangular logo balancing organic stencil text
Deep shadows isolating the subject from a dark background
Rough ground texture contrasting with smooth metallic bike parts
coreInvariants: High-contrast monochrome photography with deep blacks
A metallic or gold-toned rectangular frame for primary text
Hand-drawn or stencil-style secondary text with paint drips

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central figure at medium-full scale, leaning against a motorcycle that creates a strong diagonal from bottom-left to center.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The child's face and helmet, highlighted by a single light source.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the gold logo (top left), moves down the motorcycle fork to the wheel, then up through the subject to the stencil text (top right).
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive black negative space in the upper half and background to emphasize the subjects.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with extreme value contrast between deep blacks and bright highlights.

letterConstructionRules: Primary text is ultra-bold, condensed, and blocky
Secondary text uses irregular, hand-painted stencil strokes
Visible paint drips and spray-paint textures on secondary text
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters in the primary logo are tightly tracked to touch the frame edges
Stencil letters have varying baseline heights for a chaotic look
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Structural block lettering contrasted with expressive, chaotic stencil script.

preserve: The gold frame around the primary text
The high-contrast black and white photo style

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the ultra-bold condensed block style of the primary logo.
Provides the base for the spray-painted secondary text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast, low-key black and white photograph of a child wearing a vintage motorcycle helmet leaning against a custom chopper motorcycle. The background should be pitch black with a textured, gritty ground.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a gold rectangular frame in the top left containing ultra-bold condensed black text. In the top right, add hand-painted white stencil text at a slight upward angle with visible paint drips.

verificationChecks: Is the primary logo enclosed in a gold frame?
Does the secondary text have a spray-painted stencil texture?
Is the motorcycle positioned on a diagonal?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the children
postGenerationChecks: Check for deep black levels in the background
Ensure the gold frame is a solid, muted metallic tone
Verify the stencil text looks hand-applied
Confirm the diagonal composition of the motorcycle
Ensure no modern digital artifacts are present
recipe.reuseFormula: Low-key monochrome photography + Gold block logo frame + Spray-paint stencil overlay = Rebellious Rock Aesthetic
